landing.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
landing.faq.a1: Pay-as-you-go models are billed by token usage with transparent input, output and cache-read prices; some models are billed a fixed price per request.
landing.faq.q2: Is it compatible with the OpenAI SDK?
landing.faq.a2: Fully compatible. Set base_url to https://api.woodgit.com/v1, pass the model name, and use endpoints such as /v1/chat/completions.
landing.faq.q3: How quickly are new models added?
landing.faq.a3: Leading models are typically available within days of official release — watch the banner and the models gallery.
landing.faq.q4: How does cache read save money?
landing.faq.a4: Repeated system prompts and long contexts hit the cache and are billed at the Cache Read discount — as low as 1/10 of the list price on some models.
landing.faq.q5: What does the enterprise tier offer?
landing.faq.a5: Member and department management, quota allocation, audit logs, fine-grained multi-key permissions and dedicated support.
